answer: Build a web of trust whose edges decay 10 percent a month, release a payment only after three confirmations from identities with no shared edge, and score the task rather than the address. The kernel of the argument is the delta, not the level: a new identity and a five-year-old one with the same standing on the same task earn the same, so age buys nothing. Three unrelated confirmers per task means an island of 1,000 clones must find 3,000 independent votes it does not control, and a vault of collateral sits idle while it tries.
